notes.title: Update 3636 - Patch notes
notes.content:
http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/30/1469527565-techno-combat-gif-2.gif

Hi everyone,

We've just released a new update for The Technomancer!

This patch contains a number of bug fixes and commonly asked for gameplay improvements. 

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Here's the full patch notes:

Bug fixes:
Fixed a bug where you could be blocked in the "Under Threat" main quest.
Fixed an item duplication exploit
Fixed a bug preventing to complete the tutorial if you changed the binding before starting it
Fixed a bug where the wrong button was shown during the tutorial with a PS4 controller on PC
Fixed animation bugs on the character
Fixed two bugs preventing to complete side quests "Crowd of beggar" and "Extortion under threat" after fleeing from Ophir
Minor bug fixes
Stability improvements
Minor UI improvements

Gameplay:
Implementation of a key that toggles walking or running, bound on "Caps Lock" by default
Rework on the loot/drain binding system in keyboard/mouse controls: Loot will now always be bound on "interaction 1" (E) and drain on "interaction 2" (Q)
'Easier' Easy Mode - Following player feedback, we've reworked Easy difficulty to be more accessible. This is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy the story without investing too much time into combat.

notes.title: Meet The Technomancer’s Companions
notes.content:
http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/21/1464358607-technomancer-gif-4.gif

In The Technomancer, you’ll need strength in numbers to survive the hostile Red Planet. 

Not everyone on Mars is out to do you harm. Over the course of your adventure, you’ll gather a ragged band of companions to fight at your side. 

To overcome the many dangers that lie in wait, you’ll need to arm your party with crafted and looted equipment. Build relationships with your companions – but remember that not all will look fondly on the actions and choices you make.

When out exploring or fighting, you can select up to two companions in your party to join you. Choose carefully, as they each have their own unique fighting styles to complement your own. 

They can also make use of special talents, such as crafting, scientific knowledge, or lockpicking. Picking one companion over another has a significant impact on your experience in The Technomancer – not only in gameplay, but also on the story itself.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LUUlZAGbo60

Build Relationships, Earn Trust

Your companions all have their own agendas and preoccupations. They’ll ask for help and favours. Should you decide to accept their requests, you will trigger a special series of missions that let you learn more about their past. These personal quests add numerous hours of gameplay, improve relations with your companions and enrich the main story. 

Your companions level up alongside you. Each gets their own inventory from where you can modify their gear at any time. If you decided to level up as a crafter, you can even upgrade their equipment using your skills. This will ensure that your party is always performing at their best with regards to survivability and lethality.  

The choices you make on Mars will not only change the course of the planet, but will affect your companions as well. If your decisions consistently upset a member of your group, they may leave you behind. On the other hand, impress them enough and friendships or romances can blossom. 

http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/21/1464358388-the-technomancer-03.jpg

With Friends Like These…

Mars isn’t a world that rewards honourable deeds. Few heroes lie in wait amidst its arid, red sands. Your companions are flawed, and each have their own motivations for joining your adventure. 

Scott is one of Zachariah’s oldest friends. He is a scientist, doctor, and eccentric who suffers from a crippling alcohol addiction.  

Amelia is an expedition driver with a lot of experience on the road. Adventuring is in her blood, so she loves to learn about lost cities and relics from before the Turmoil. 

Phobos is a strong and powerful mutant who only desires for his people to be united. Unlike most mutants, he is well-educated and sees a light wherever there’s darkness. The passion he has for his people is unrivalled, so it would be a bad idea to mistreat them in his presence.  

http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/21/1464358387-the-technomancer-06.jpg

These are just a few of the many companions you can potentially recruit on your journey across the Red Planet. Some will be assigned to you unwillingly, others may join because it benefits them. Whatever the circumstances, their future, and Mars’ destiny, is in your hands.
   
Forge the destiny of Mars in this epic sci-fi RPG, available June 28, on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.
